Disseminations of Reports / Inflated trending topic around Batam data center

Inflated trending topic around Batam data center

Published 25 October 2026

Ishak Martins, Adisty Ramadhani

Lokanetra Information Observatory

investasi ai batam#DataCenterBatam

Download PDF

Introduction

The Batam data center topic on X ran from 20/10/2026 14:12 to 21/10/2026 19:55 GMT+7 under the keywords investasi ai batam and #DataCenterBatam. The draft title calls the topic inflated. The report covers tweet volume, account counts, engagement, posting times, top accounts, top words and hashtags, emotion labels and evidence tiers in the dataset.

Findings

  • The dataset holds 1,287 tweets from 1,219 unique accounts. Original posts number 1,215, replies 58 and quotes 14.
  • Engagement totals 375: 230 likes, 91 retweets and 54 comments.
  • The busiest hour is 20/10/2026 14:00 GMT+7 with 771 tweets. The dataset lists 2 burst hours.
  • Two accounts post 5 tweets each: BahryAulia97 and AaliaImani. Eight accounts post 3 tweets each: LexZiger, exacstly_, valyaobong, AriesHutab2, vonycuwy, entikmlenuk, nanapaijah and AlfaBet_4.
  • Top words are batam 1,993, investasi 1,269, digital 664, peluang 627 and teknologi 615. Top hashtags are #datacenterbatam 1,239, #emoneyrp1 16 and #howeawards2026 11.
  • Evidence tiers over 1,219 accounts are T0 1,014, T1 4, T2 201 and T3 0.

Remarks

The data covers one period and two keywords, so it cannot show reach outside this pull. Emotion labels cover 129 tweets, the top 10% by reactions, and a tweet can carry several labels. The 201 T2 accounts and 2 burst hours are signals in the dataset and do not prove automation, payment or coordination. Next steps are a longer window, a wider keyword set and account-level histories.

Amplification

Source: Kestrel Parts D and E. 1,219 accounts. Tiers describe evidence found in this dataset. They are not a claim that an account is automated, paid or coordinated.

Evidence tiers

Accounts per evidence tier

T0No signals
1,014 accounts, 83%

Nothing in this corpus separates this account from ordinary participation.

T1Burst participation only
4 accounts, 0%

The account posted inside an amplification burst and nothing else fired. Never filtered: posting during a spike is what an interested human does too.

T2Metadata-suspicious
201 accounts, 16%

At least two independent evidence families fired (burst-exclusive posting, creation inside a creation burst, extreme profile metadata, high near-duplicate/self-repetition).

T3Coordinated
0 accounts, 0%

This account sits in a cluster that stayed outside the permutation null after FDR correction. The strongest evidence tier, and the only one the de-amplified corpus removes by default.
